lyrics:
[Intro: bright synth hook, steady drum machine, pulsing bass]

[Verse 1: smooth, light, rueful]
You were laughing at a table by the door
Wearing something I had never seen before
I raised a hand like a fool who'd been forgiven
You looked right through me like a window

[Pre-Chorus: pads swell, falsetto]
And I stood there with my drink and my nerve
Getting just what I deserve

[Chorus: full beat, synth hook answers, doubled voice]
You looked right through me
Like I was weather, like I was glass
I had it coming, I know, I know
I made you cry and I let it pass
Now I'm the ghost at the party
You looked right through me
Good for you

[Verse 2: smooth, lower]
I remember what I said and how I said it
I remember that you asked and I just let it
Go, like it was nothing, like a coat I didn't need
Funny what a person leaves

[Pre-Chorus: pads swell, falsetto]
And I stood there with my drink and my nerve
Getting just what I deserve

[Chorus: full beat, synth hook answers, doubled voice]
You looked right through me
Like I was weather, like I was glass
I had it coming, I know, I know
I made you cry and I let it pass
Now I'm the ghost at the party
You looked right through me
Good for you

[Bridge: drums drop out, falsetto over pads]
I won't come over
I won't say your name
I'll finish this and go

[Final Chorus: everything, falsetto ad-libs, extra synth line]
You looked right through me
Like I was weather, like I was glass
I had it coming, I know, I know
I made you cry and I let it pass
Now I'm the ghost at the party
You looked right through me
